primaryCue.zh: 躯干前倾，双腿伸直抬离地面，再慢慢放下
primaryCue.en: Lean forwards, lift both straight legs off the mat, then lower them slowly

primaryCue.zh: 后腿膝盖保持贴垫，慢慢抬起左脚和小腿，再放下
primaryCue.en: Keep the rear knee on the mat, slowly lift your left foot and shin, then lower them

phase.peak.en: Keep the rear knee on the mat

primaryCue.zh: 脚心相对，膝盖慢慢打开再收回
primaryCue.en: Soles together, open the knees slowly and bring them back
Hug your knees and breathe slowly

phase.start.en: Exhale and bring your knees a little closer

primaryCue.zh: 膝盖并拢，小腿慢慢向上抬
primaryCue.en: Knees together, lift the shin up slowly

primaryCue.zh: 双膝倒向一侧，肩膀贴地
primaryCue.en: Drop both knees to one side, shoulders stay down

phase.start.en: Lower both knees slowly to one side

primaryCue.zh: 手在身后撑地，一侧膝盖向内倒
primaryCue.en: Hands behind you, drop one knee inward

phase.start.en: Let the knee move inward slowly

primaryCue.zh: 抱住一边膝盖，另一条腿放松伸直
primaryCue.en: Hug one knee, let the other leg rest straight
